title: blueprint-foreman fire
description: The fire as Specification v1 gives it: one JSON object, the text a routine is fired with, which the session hands verbatim to the engine's `wake` on stdin. The engine validates every fire against this file with its own code. A fire whose key or branches it cannot read writes nothing; any other it refuses is signalled `failed` on the agent's branch.

specification.description: The version of the specification the fire follows.

key.description: The work item's key: a letter, then letters, digits and hyphens, as `PROJ-1` or `PROJ-SAMPLE`; a name every path and branch it goes into takes whole.

title.description: The work item's title, for people.

branch.description: Blueprint's branch for the item, B, as origin names it without `refs/heads/`. One or more segments joined by `/`, each of letters, digits, `.`, `_` and `-`, starting with a letter, a digit or `_`, ending with neither `.` nor `.lock`, with no `..` anywhere; not under `claude/`.

agentBranch.description: The agent's branch, F: `claude/` and B's name. The run works only here, cutting it from B's tip where origin does not have it, else continuing it.

pullRequest.description: The item's pull request, from B to the default branch, which Blueprint opened; for people.

design.description: Where the design is: `<docsRoot>/<KEY>/blueprint.md`, relative to the repository's root.

signal.description: The git trailer key under which the agent signals its state on F.

answer.description: A person's reply to the run's last `needs-human`, or null.

options.description: Options Blueprint passes through untouched. This harness ignores them: its practices, models and Adversary are the routine's environment's.
